worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.summary: Rapid alternating punches on a beat: each beat sweeps a small fan in front, and faster users throw more; after the string, those struck may be left dizzy, so their attempts fumble and they hurt themselves.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.use.0: Throw a string of punches on a beat at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.use.1: Daze several foes caught in the small fan
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.use.2: Use the confusion to open a fumble window
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.description: Throws %2$s punches on a %3$s beat, each spanning a %4$s degree fan over a %5$s block reach and dealing %1$s contact and punch damage.
When the string ends, anyone struck has a %1$s chance to be confused for %2$s: each attempt to act has a %3$s chance to be scattered, and hitting a non-ally makes the target hurt itself.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.rapid.on: Rapid flurry: one extra punch, a tighter beat, shorter wind-up, recovery and cooldown, but each punch x0.82, a shorter and rarer confusion.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.rapid.off: Heavy beat: fewer, heavier punches that confuse more easily, but a slower cycle.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.growth.0: From level %1$s each punch rises to %2$s and the punch count to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dizzypunch.growth.1: From level %1$s each punch rises to %2$s and the confusion to %3$s.
On: +1 punch, -1 tick on the beat, -2 wind-up and recovery, -4 cooldown, but each punch x0.82, confusion duration x0.85 and chance -5%%. Off (heavy beat): fewer, heavier punches that confuse more easily, but a slower cycle.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: when foes crowd beside the target the user flurries first, catching several in the small fan; off: order by ordinary melee only.
On: low-health targets rank first, finishing them with the string; off: all targets score the same.
